title: Clever Strategy Game Where YOU Terraform A Barren Planet! - Terra Nil
creator: Aliensrock
method: Chrome player, paused timestamp samples and adjacent early-placement frames; not continuous full-video viewing, installed-game testing or audio analysis. Cropped browser screenshots retain the creator's editing and facecam.
limits: Edited video includes zooms, enlarged HUD inserts and held tool explanations; do not infer native UI scale, tooltip duration, continuous chronology, animation duration or hidden mechanics. User-supplied images have unknown timestamps/version. Buffering frame at 10:00 was replaced after reinspection.

frames.observed: Bright turbine ghost on highlighted rock; illustrated tool panel pairs output and required surface.
frames.apply: Match icon, ghost and eligible ground; requirements should be visible before a click.

frames.observed: Toxin scrubber explanation is anchored to its toolbar card; illustration, outputs, requirements, handbook and close controls are visible.
frames.apply: Tool-focus explanation should explain purpose and constraints; do not copy its large size.

frames.observed: Green scrubber candidate, affected ground, blue turbine region, connecting line and local 2/6 electricity badge appear together.
frames.apply: Separate occupied footprint from relevant context; show actual existing connections only.

frames.observed: Irrigator candidate, outlined affected terrain, rotation affordance and +116 local number. Enlarged/held explanation is also visible in the edited video.
frames.apply: Keep candidate-specific information beside the candidate. Do not import rotation or resource rewards.

frames.observed: Placed irrigator and a patch of new greenery; particles and spray are visible; resource display differs from preview.
frames.apply: Preview and committed appearance should differ. Timed spread/particles are explicitly outside this proposal.

frames.observed: Green land is legible with machine silhouettes; an editorial enlargement emphasizes the resource/progress HUD.
frames.apply: Read settled terrain clearly; never derive native HUD dimensions from the edited insert.

frames.observed: Scrubber ghost sits within a colored candidate area; turbine has a local 3/6 badge and a bright connection to the candidate.
frames.apply: Use a clear local relationship rather than requiring panel-to-map inference.

frames.observed: Same selected scrubber card remains outlined while its world ghost is red outside the visible blue region. The exact rejection text is not visible in this sampled frame.
frames.apply: Retain tool identity on a blocked target, but improve on color alone with a text reason.

frames.observed: Edited close view of an irrigator candidate: green area, holes/edges in contrasting color, rotation hint and local +116.
frames.apply: The affected shape is specific; do not treat this as uninterrupted recovery of the scrubber shown at 01:05.

frames.observed: Edited close-up includes a large undo control and bottom tool costs.
frames.apply: Undo is easy to recognize; exact apparent size is editorial, not a layout measurement.

frames.observed: Water-pump preview follows the channel shape; illustration includes the terrain context and prerequisite icons.
frames.apply: Use the real spatial domain of an existing action; a swale connection overlay should not be a generic circle.

frames.observed: Wide play view has broad treated/untreated land masses, recognizable machines and a compact bottom rail.
frames.apply: Orient the player through terrain and object contrast; no permanent all-map grid.

frames.observed: Different tool set and segmented corner goal graphic; beehive explanation pairs miniature, requirement and outcome.
frames.apply: Stable palette structure can hold different tools; no new tiers or goal wheel proposed.

frames.observed: Large fire effect over terrain and machines.
frames.apply: Explicitly excluded: no fire propagation or timed-world response work.

frames.observed: Illustrated handbook page explains a new stage using a paired symbol and short passage.
frames.apply: Keep help visual and reopenable; no new recycling/animal stage proposed.

frames.observed: Blue circular scan region over water and banks; another tool uses another geometry.
frames.apply: Name an overlay's meaning; do not confuse range, occupied footprint and eligible site.

frames.observed: Dense final landscape remains readable under corner status, numbered tool tabs and a short bottom palette.
